encryption_at_rest_enabled.title: Encryption at Rest Enabled
encryption_at_rest_enabled.description: Whether full-volume or full-disk encryption is actively enabled on the storage medium containing sensitive data

encryption_algorithm.title: Encryption Algorithm
encryption_algorithm.description: The symmetric encryption algorithm and mode configured for data at rest encryption on the volume or storage system.

key_length_bits.title: Encryption Key Length (bits)
key_length_bits.description: The length of the symmetric encryption key in bits used for data at rest encryption.

encryption_coverage_scope.title: Encryption Coverage Scope
encryption_coverage_scope.description: Indicates which portions of the storage volume are covered by encryption (full volume vs. partial/files-only vs. none), including OS partitions, swap, and temp files.

swap_space_encrypted.title: Swap Space Encrypted
swap_space_encrypted.description: Whether swap partitions or swap files are included within the encrypted volume or separately encrypted, preventing sensitive in-memory data from persisting unencrypted.

hibernation_file_encrypted.title: Hibernation File Encrypted
hibernation_file_encrypted.description: Whether the hibernation file (hiberfil.sys on Windows, /var/vm/sleepimage on macOS) is protected by full-volume encryption, preventing memory contents from being extracted after hibernation.

unencrypted_remnant_partitions.title: Unencrypted Remnant Partitions
unencrypted_remnant_partitions.description: List of partition labels or mount points that exist on the volume but are NOT covered by encryption (e.g., unencrypted /boot, recovery partitions with sensitive data).

key_management_system_type.title: Key Management System Type
key_management_system_type.description: The type of key management system used to store and manage encryption keys, which determines separation of keys from data and overall key governance quality.

keys_colocated_with_data.title: Keys Co-located with Encrypted Data
keys_colocated_with_data.description: Whether encryption key material is stored on the same system or volume as the data it protects.

key_rotation_enabled.title: Automatic Key Rotation Enabled
key_rotation_enabled.description: Whether automatic periodic rotation of encryption keys is enabled and configured.

key_revocation_capability.title: Key Revocation Capability Present
key_revocation_capability.description: Whether the key management system supports immediate key revocation or disabling to prevent further decryption.

cryptographic_erasure_supported.title: Cryptographic Erasure Capability Supported
cryptographic_erasure_supported.description: Whether the encryption implementation supports cryptographic erasure (crypto-erase) by allowing destruction or deletion of the encryption key to render data unrecoverable.

key_management_policy.title: Encryption Key Management Policy
key_management_policy.description: Describes how encryption keys are managed, which affects whether cryptographic erasure is reliably achievable during decommissioning.

encryption_audit_tooling_enabled.title: Encryption Audit Tooling Enabled
encryption_audit_tooling_enabled.description: Indicates whether automated tooling (e.g., cloud provider compliance checks, disk encryption scanners, CSPM tools) is actively configured to detect and report on encryption status of volumes, disks, or file systems.

encryption_coverage_visibility_scope.title: Encryption Coverage Visibility Scope
encryption_coverage_visibility_scope.description: The scope of encryption status visibility — whether all storage resources (volumes, disks, file systems) are inventoried and their encryption state is known and reportable.

unencrypted_volumes_detected.title: Unencrypted Volumes Detected
unencrypted_volumes_detected.description: Indicates whether the audit tooling has detected any volumes, disks, or file systems that are confirmed to be unencrypted at rest.

hsm_tpm_binding_enabled.title: HSM/TPM Key Binding Enabled
hsm_tpm_binding_enabled.description: Whether encryption keys are bound to a hardware security module (HSM) or trusted platform module (TPM), preventing software-level key extraction.

hardware_binding_type.title: Hardware Binding Type
hardware_binding_type.description: The type of hardware root of trust used for key binding.

key_extraction_protection_verified.title: Key Extraction Protection Verified
key_extraction_protection_verified.description: Whether it has been confirmed that raw key material cannot be exported from the hardware boundary, even by privileged software actors (e.g., non-exportable key policy enforced).

encryption_policy_enabled.title: Encryption Policy Enabled
encryption_policy_enabled.description: Whether a centralized encryption policy is actively enforced across managed endpoints or storage systems.

policy_compliance_status.title: Policy Compliance Status
policy_compliance_status.description: The current compliance state of the endpoint or storage system against the encryption policy.

enforcement_scope.title: Enforcement Scope
enforcement_scope.description: The coverage level of the encryption policy — whether it applies to all volumes, only system volumes, or is limited in scope.

rotation_period_days.title: Key Rotation Period (Days)
rotation_period_days.description: The configured interval in days between automatic key rotations; 0 or null indicates no rotation schedule is set.
